quotes.text_id: Kualitasnya jauh di atas ekspektasi. Warnanya persis di layar, potongan stikernya rapi banget. Terima kasih Nae!
quotes.text_en: Quality was way above what I expected. Colors match the screen, sticker cuts are so clean. Thank you Nae!
quotes.author: Reyza P.

quotes.text_id: Keychain BNHA-nya udah nyantol di tas sekolah adek dan dipuji-puji temen-temennya. Bakal balik lagi.
quotes.text_en: The BNHA keychain is on my little sister's school bag and her friends love it. Definitely coming back.
quotes.author: Nadia K.

quotes.text_id: Aku suka kalau art print-nya dikirim dengan hard packaging biar ga penyok. Perhatian kecil kayak gini penting.
quotes.text_en: I love that art prints ship in hard packaging so they do not bend. Small details like this matter.
quotes.author: Bagus W.

quotes.text_id: Photocard Haikyuu Halu edition-nya CANTIK. Nemu di FYP TikTok trus langsung checkout. Ga nyesel.
quotes.text_en: The Haikyuu Halu edition photocard is GORGEOUS. Found it on TikTok FYP and checked out right away. No regrets.
quotes.author: Alya M.
